description: This file defines the AuthProvider class for managing authentication state within a Flutter application. It uses ChangeNotifier for reactive updates and interacts with an AuthService to perform login, registration, initialization, and logout operations. The class maintains user information, loading status, and error messages.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider class for managing authentication state in a Flutter app.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the authentication status by checking if the user is logged in and fetching the current user data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, updates user state on success.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with provided details, updates user state on success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and clears user data.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Private method to update loading status and notify listeners.
